reason: Refactors exception handling in the widely-used InvokeExtensions/ContentItemDisplayCoordinator dispatch paths, but preserves the existing fatal-vs-non-fatal swallow/log semantics (now via exception filters instead of rethrow), so behavior for content display/editor building across all modules should remain equivalent.
